title: SRE Copilot - Incident Response Overview
description: Real-time monitoring of autonomous incident response

layout.title: Active Incidents
layout.query: SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE serviceName = 'sre-copilot-orchestrator' AND attributes['incident.status'] = 'escalated'

layout.title: Incidents Resolved (24h)
layout.query: SELECT count(*) FROM traces WHERE serviceName = 'sre-copilot-orchestrator' AND attributes['incident.status'] = 'resolved' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

layout.title: Mean Time To Resolution
layout.query: SELECT avg(durationNano) / 1000000000 FROM traces WHERE serviceName = 'sre-copilot-orchestrator' AND name = 'incident.handle'

layout.title: MCP Query Latency
layout.query: SELECT avg(durationNano) / 1000000 FROM traces WHERE name LIKE 'mcp.%' GROUP BY name
